songs.sangeetVersion: Combo A. Dhol-style bounce, ek-hath-upar with a finger pointing up on the chorus, squad forms a circle.

songs.title: Jhoome Jo Pathaan
songs.artist: Pathaan (2023), Arijit Singh & Sukriti Kakar, Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone
songs.hookSteps: choreographer Bosco Martis kept it cool and easy (“universally achievable”). Simplified: 1) relaxed bounce ×4, 2) side sway with loose arm swings, 3) open-arms pose, 4) repeat. Use the tutorial for exact counts.
songs.sangeetVersion: Combo C. Whole squad in a line copies the same two counts; stay laid-back, no jumping.

songs.title: Tauba Tauba
songs.artist: Karan Aujla, Bad Newz (2024), Vicky Kaushal, choreographed by Bosco Martis
songs.hookSteps: 1) Twist your right leg and do the “tauba” step. 2) Twist your feet outward and do the tauba step with the opposite hand and leg. 3) Step forward once, then step back using the tauba step on the opposite side. 4) Add small sharp jerks and some swag.
songs.sangeetVersion: Do the hook on every “tauba tauba” line and Combo B in the verses. Squad in two lines looks great. Slow it down to half speed to learn.

songs.title: Malhari
songs.artist: Bajirao Mastani (2015), Vishal Dadlani, Ranveer Singh
songs.hookSteps: simplified from the video: 1) wide stance, fists at chest. 2) Stomp forward and thump your chest. 3) Swing both arms up and over with a hop. 4) Repeat on each “Malhari”.
songs.sangeetVersion: Power version: stomp, chest-thump, arms-up roar on the dhol hits. Groom can lead from the front.
